title: Network

list.name: device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_name FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'if_hc_in_octets.%' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, value AS "WAN Download" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_rx_bps' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "WAN Upload" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_tx_bps' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_up' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, value FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_latency_ms' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "Download" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_speedtest_down_mbps' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "Upload" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_speedtest_up_mbps' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "GW CPU %" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_gw_cpu_pct' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "GW Mem %" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_wan_gw_mem_pct' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, metadata->>'band' AS metric, value FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_clients_by_band' AND metadata->>'band' <> 'other' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_clients_total' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "Wired" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_clients_wired' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "Wireless" FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_clients_wireless' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.metadata->>'device' AS metric, m.value FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics m JOIN (SELECT metadata->>'device' AS device, max(ts) AS mts FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric='unifi_ap_clients' GROUP BY 1) latest ON latest.device = m.metadata->>'device' AND latest.mts = m.ts WHERE m.metric = 'unifi_ap_clients' ORDER BY m.value DESC
SELECT ts AS time, (metadata->>'device') || ' ' || (metadata->>'band') AS metric, value FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric = 'unifi_ap_radio_satisfaction' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

WITH latest AS (SELECT metric, metadata->>'device' AS device, metadata->>'port_name' AS port_name, (metadata->>'port')::int AS port, value, ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric, metadata->>'device', metadata->>'port' ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.unifi_metrics WHERE metric IN ('unifi_port_rx_errors','unifi_port_tx_errors','unifi_port_rx_dropped','unifi_port_tx_dropped')) SELECT device AS "Device", port AS "Port", port_name AS "Port Name", COALESCE(max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='unifi_port_rx_errors'),0) AS "RX Err", COALESCE(max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='unifi_port_tx_errors'),0) AS "TX Err", COALESCE(max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='unifi_port_rx_dropped'),0) AS "RX Drop", COALESCE(max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='unifi_port_tx_dropped'),0) AS "TX Drop", COALESCE(sum(value),0) AS "Total Errors" FROM latest WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY device, port, port_name HAVING COALESCE(sum(value),0) > 0 ORDER BY "Total Errors" DESC LIMIT 15

WITH latest AS (SELECT source, component_id, component_name, used_pct, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source, component_id ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.storage_metrics WHERE used_pct IS NOT NULL AND component_type IN ('volume','system','share')) SELECT source || ' / ' || component_name AS metric, used_pct AS value FROM latest WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT source, component_id, component_name, temp_c, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source, component_id ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.storage_metrics WHERE temp_c IS NOT NULL AND component_type='disk') SELECT component_id || ' (' || component_name || ')' AS metric, temp_c AS value FROM latest WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY temp_c DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT source, component_id, component_name, smart_status, temp_c, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source, component_id ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.storage_metrics WHERE component_type='disk') SELECT component_id AS "Disk", component_name AS "Model", smart_status AS "SMART", temp_c AS "Temp C" FROM latest WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY (smart_status='normal'), component_id
SELECT latency_ms FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT packet_loss_pct FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE packet_loss_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT down_mbps FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE down_mbps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT client_mac) AS active_clients FROM telemetry.network WHERE ts >= now() - interval '5 minutes'
SELECT ts AS time, latency_ms AS value, 'latency ms' AS metric FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, packet_loss_pct AS value, 'packet loss %' AS metric FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE packet_loss_pct IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, down_mbps AS value, 'down Mbps' AS metric FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE down_mbps IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, up_mbps AS value, 'up Mbps' AS metric FROM telemetry.wan_quality WHERE up_mbps IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT client_name, ip, round((max(rx_bytes)+max(tx_bytes))/1e9, 2) AS gb, max(signal_dbm) AS signal_dbm FROM telemetry.network WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY client_name, ip ORDER BY gb DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT ts AS time, signal_dbm AS value, client_name AS metric FROM telemetry.network WHERE is_wired = false AND signal_dbm IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ap_name, count(DISTINCT client_mac) AS clients FROM telemetry.network WHERE ts >= now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY ap_name ORDER BY clients DESC
SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'cpu_used_pct' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp
SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'hr_cpu_load_avg' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT t.timestamp AS time, t.device_name AS metric, CASE WHEN t.metric_value > 0 THEN 100.0 * (t.metric_value - a.metric_value) / t.metric_value ELSE 0 END AS value FROM snmp_metrics t JOIN snmp_metrics a ON a.device_name = t.device_name AND a.metric_name = 'mem_avail_real' AND a.timestamp = t.timestamp WHERE t.metric_name = 'mem_total_real' AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) ORDER BY t.timestamp
SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name || ' system' AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'sys_temp' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

WITH latest AS (SELECT device_name, metric_value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY device_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'hr_cpu_load_avg' AND timestamp > now() - interval '15 min') SELECT device_name AS "Device", round(metric_value::numeric, 1) AS "Avg CPU %" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT device_name, metric_value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY device_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'sys_uptime' AND timestamp > now() - interval '20 min') SELECT device_name AS "Device", metric_value / 100 AS "Uptime" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT m.timestamp AS time, m.device_name || ' ' || COALESCE(n.unit, 'if' || split_part(m.metric_name, '.', 2)) AS metric, m.metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT unit FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name = m.device_name AND metric_name = 'if_name.' || split_part(m.metric_name, '.', 2) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE m.metric_name LIKE 'if_in_bps.%' AND m.device_name IN ($device) AND $__timeFilter(m.timestamp) ORDER BY m.timestamp

SELECT m.timestamp AS time, m.device_name || ' ' || COALESCE(n.unit, 'if' || split_part(m.metric_name, '.', 2)) AS metric, m.metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT unit FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name = m.device_name AND metric_name = 'if_name.' || split_part(m.metric_name, '.', 2) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE m.metric_name LIKE 'if_out_bps.%' AND m.device_name IN ($device) AND $__timeFilter(m.timestamp) ORDER BY m.timestamp

WITH latest AS (SELECT device_name, metric_name, metric_value, split_part(metric_name, '.', 2) AS idx, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY device_name, metric_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name ~ '^if_(in|out)_(errors|discards)\.' AND timestamp > now() - interval '20 min') SELECT l.device_name AS "Device", COALESCE(n.unit, 'if' || l.idx) AS "Port", SUM(l.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_name LIKE 'if_in_errors%') AS "RX Errors", SUM(l.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_name LIKE 'if_out_errors%') AS "TX Errors", SUM(l.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_name LIKE 'if_in_discards%') AS "RX Discards", SUM(l.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_name LIKE 'if_out_discards%') AS "TX Discards" FROM latest l LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT unit FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name = l.device_name AND metric_name = 'if_name.' || l.idx ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE l.rn = 1 GROUP BY l.device_name, l.idx, n.unit HAVING SUM(l.metric_value) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST, 1, 2

WITH latest AS (SELECT device_name, metric_name, metric_value, split_part(metric_name, '.', 2) AS idx, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY device_name, metric_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name ~ '^if_(oper_status|speed_mbps)\.' AND device_name IN ($device) AND timestamp > now() - interval '20 min') SELECT l.device_name AS "Device", COALESCE(n.unit, 'if' || l.idx) AS "Port", MAX(l.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_name LIKE 'if_oper_status%') AS "Status", MAX(l.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_name LIKE 'if_speed_mbps%') AS "Speed Mbps" FROM latest l LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT unit FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name = l.device_name AND metric_name = 'if_name.' || l.idx ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE l.rn = 1 GROUP BY l.device_name, l.idx, n.unit ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT count(*) AS "devices" FROM dns_records
SELECT count(*) AS "active" FROM dns_records WHERE updated_at > now()-interval '15 minutes'
SELECT count(*) AS "new" FROM dns_records WHERE first_seen > now()-interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) AS "stale" FROM dns_records WHERE updated_at < now()-interval '7 days'
SELECT date_trunc('day', first_seen) AS time, count(*) AS value, 'new devices' AS metric FROM dns_records WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT name||'.nova' AS "Name", ip AS "IP", mac AS "MAC", first_seen AS "First seen", updated_at AS "Last seen", CASE WHEN locked THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS "Locked" FROM dns_records ORDER BY updated_at DESC

panels.title: Nova — UniFi — Threat Watch, Stalker, House Arrest

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM unifi_threat_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' AND NOT ignored
SELECT count(*) FROM unifi_threat_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' AND risk='high' AND action <> 'block' AND NOT ignored
SELECT count(*) FROM unifi_client_state WHERE online
SELECT count(*) FROM unifi_client_events WHERE kind='roam' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) FROM unifi_toolkit_ledger WHERE kind IN ('policy','acl') AND released_at IS NULL
SELECT jsonb_array_length(findings) FROM unifi_network_audit ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1h), count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk='high') AS high, count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk='medium') AS medium, count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk='low') AS low FROM unifi_threat_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND NOT ignored GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Threat Watch — IPS events by risk

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_ip::text AS source, max(src_country) AS cc, count(*) AS events, max(risk) AS worst, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'block') AS not_blocked, max(ts) AS last FROM unifi_threat_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' AND NOT ignored GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT ts, risk, action, left(signature, 90) AS signature, src_ip::text AS src, src_country AS cc, dst_ip::text AS dst, dst_port FROM unifi_threat_events WHERE NOT ignored ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(hour, 1h), count(DISTINCT mac) AS clients FROM unifi_client_presence WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Network Pulse — distinct clients per hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT ap, count(*) AS clients, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_wired) AS wifi FROM unifi_client_state WHERE online GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Network Pulse — clients per AP / port (now)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.label, t.mac, s.online, s.ap, s.essid, s.signal, s.ip, s.last_seen FROM unifi_tracked_devices t LEFT JOIN unifi_client_state s USING (mac) ORDER BY t.label
SELECT e.ts, e.kind, coalesce(s.name, s.hostname, e.mac) AS device, e.from_ap, e.to_ap FROM unifi_client_events e LEFT JOIN unifi_client_state s USING (mac) ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Wi-Fi Stalker — latest connect / roam / leave

targets.rawSql: SELECT f->>'severity' AS severity, f->>'where' AS network, f->>'finding' AS finding, f->>'detail' AS detail FROM (SELECT findings FROM unifi_network_audit ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) a, jsonb_array_elements(a.findings) f

panels.title: House Arrest — network posture findings (latest audit)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, action, dry_run, ok, actor, left(args::text, 120) AS args FROM unifi_toolkit_actions ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT left("flow_id"::text, 120) AS "flow_id", "ts", left("risk"::text, 120) AS "risk", left("action"::text, 120) AS "action", left("signature"::text, 120) AS "signature", left("signature_id"::text, 120) AS "signature_id", left("category"::text, 120) AS "category", "src_ip" FROM "unifi_threat_events" ORDER BY "ts" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_threat_events" WHERE "ts" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("ts", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_threat_events" WHERE $__timeFilter("ts") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT "id", "cidr", left("max_risk"::text, 120) AS "max_risk", left("note"::text, 120) AS "note", "created_at" FROM "unifi_threat_ignore" ORDER BY "created_at" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_threat_ignore" WHERE "created_at" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("created_at", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_threat_ignore" WHERE $__timeFilter("created_at") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "id", "ts", left("mac"::text, 120) AS "mac", left("kind"::text, 120) AS "kind", left("from_ap"::text, 120) AS "from_ap", left("to_ap"::text, 120) AS "to_ap", left("detail"::text, 120) AS "detail" FROM "unifi_client_events" ORDER BY "ts" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_client_events" WHERE "ts" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("ts", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_client_events" WHERE $__timeFilter("ts") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT left("mac"::text, 120) AS "mac", left("name"::text, 120) AS "name", left("hostname"::text, 120) AS "hostname", left("ip"::text, 120) AS "ip", left("oui"::text, 120) AS "oui", "is_wired", left("ap"::text, 120) AS "ap", left("essid"::text, 120) AS "essid" FROM "unifi_client_state" ORDER BY "updated_at" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_client_state" WHERE "updated_at" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("updated_at", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_client_state" WHERE $__timeFilter("updated_at") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT left("mac"::text, 120) AS "mac", "hour", left("ap"::text, 120) AS "ap", "samples" FROM "unifi_client_presence" LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_client_presence"
SELECT left("mac"::text, 120) AS "mac", left("label"::text, 120) AS "label", "alert", "added_at" FROM "unifi_tracked_devices" LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_tracked_devices"

SELECT "id", "ts", left("digest"::text, 120) AS "digest", left("findings"::text, 120) AS "findings", left("lockdowns"::text, 120) AS "lockdowns", left("matrix"::text, 120) AS "matrix" FROM "unifi_network_audit" ORDER BY "ts" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_network_audit" WHERE "ts" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("ts", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_network_audit" WHERE $__timeFilter("ts") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT left("obj_id"::text, 120) AS "obj_id", left("kind"::text, 120) AS "kind", left("label"::text, 120) AS "label", left("payload"::text, 120) AS "payload", left("before"::text, 120) AS "before", "created_at", "released_at" FROM "unifi_toolkit_ledger" ORDER BY "created_at" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_toolkit_ledger" WHERE "created_at" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("created_at", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_toolkit_ledger" WHERE $__timeFilter("created_at") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "id", "ts", left("action"::text, 120) AS "action", left("args"::text, 120) AS "args", "dry_run", "ok", left("result"::text, 120) AS "result", left("host"::text, 120) AS "host" FROM "unifi_toolkit_actions" ORDER BY "ts" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM "unifi_toolkit_actions" WHERE "ts" > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("ts", 1h), count(*) AS rows FROM "unifi_toolkit_actions" WHERE $__timeFilter("ts") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
